title: PNWPHP 2017 CfP
content:
We are happy to announce the dates for *Pacific Northwest PHP Conference (PNWPHP) 2017 are September 7-9, and will held at University of Washington in Seattle! The CFP site - - has launched, where talk submissions will accepted through May 15th, 2017.http://cfp.pnwphp.com

The is a 3-day event in Seattle, Washington for PHP and Web developers. Our past conferences have included from the PHP community, about a — from APIs and CMS to unit testing and version controlPacific Northwest PHP Conferenceworld renown speakerswide range of topics

For more details, go to http://pnwphp.com
